lines.adehone-build-resolver: Minimal-change build and typecheck fixes, stopping when the same error survives 3 attempts.
lines.adehone-code-review: Severity-ranked review of correctness, TypeScript, React, Electron boundaries, and repository rules.
lines.adehone-electron-architecture: Main, preload, and renderer roles, and IPC contracts with sender checks, input validation, and no generic bridge.
lines.adehone-electron-security: The 20-item Electron security checklist, secrets, and review-only guidance for packaging, signing, and auto-update.
lines.adehone-planner: Reads repository rules and work-item contracts, reports feasibility questions first, and checks platform, remote, mobile, and folder workspace impact.
lines.adehone-react-ui: The repository design system first, then React state, effects, accessibility, and performance.
lines.adehone-testing-proof: Proof by running, committed tests only as an exception, and hidden background UI checks.
lines.adehone-verification-loop: The repository gate plus diff, execution proof, security, and environment checks; unchecked means unverified.
lines.android-clean-architecture: Clean Architecture module boundaries, pure-Kotlin domain, UseCases, Repositories, Mappers, and Hilt DI.
lines.android-compose-patterns: Android Jetpack Compose state management, Event Sink, Type-Safe Navigation, WindowInsets, and TalkBack a11y.
lines.android-java-legacy: Legacy Android Java maintenance, Java-Kotlin interop, memory leak fixes, JUnit+Mockito tests, and Desugaring.
lines.android-planner: 4-step planning process, Search-First reuse, phased steps, testing strategy, and risk mitigations.
lines.android-security-webview: Transport/E2EE encryption, hardened WebView JS bridge, 11 Device APIs, MDM/MAM, secure keypad, and FCM push.
lines.android-verification-loop: 6-phase verification gate (build, lint/static, tests/Kover, security grep, diff review, adb acceptance).
lines.bug-reproduction: Write down the exact steps that show the bug before looking for its cause.
lines.ci-failure-triage: Tell a flaky check from a real failure or broken infrastructure, and find the commit that started it.
lines.dependency-upgrade: Upgrade one group at a time, read the changelog, run the tests, one pull request each.
lines.feedback-themes: Group feedback into themes with counts and short quotes; link existing issues.
lines.gradle-build-resolver: Surgical Gradle/Kotlin build error resolution, dependency conflict debugging, SDK guardrails, and R8 rules.
lines.incident-timeline: Keep a timestamped timeline, then draft a blameless write-up.
lines.ios-clean-architecture: Clean Architecture layer boundaries, pure-Swift Domain, UseCases, Repositories, ObjC adapters, and Protocol DI.
lines.ios-planner: 4-step planning process, Search-First reuse, phased steps, testing strategy, and risk mitigations.
lines.ios-security-webview: Transport/E2EE encryption, hardened WKWebView JS bridge, 11 Device APIs, MDM/MAM, secure keypad, and APNs push.
lines.ios-swiftui-patterns: Modern SwiftUI @Observable state, @Environment DI, NavigationStack, WKWebView/UIKit lifecycle, and VoiceOver a11y.
lines.ios-verification-loop: 6-phase verification gate (build, SwiftLint/format, tests/coverage, security grep, diff review, simctl acceptance).
lines.issue-triage: Label, find duplicates, ask for missing repro details in one comment.
lines.kotlin-code-review: Severity-ranked Kotlin/Android code review for architecture, security, coroutines, Compose, and Gradle.
lines.kotlin-coroutines-flows: Idiomatic Kotlin, structured concurrency, StateFlow/SharedFlow, dispatcher injection, and cancellation safety.
lines.kotlin-tdd-testing: TDD workflow with JUnit/Kotest, MockK, Fake repositories, runTest, Turbine Flow testing, and Kover coverage.
lines.mobile-web-build-resolver: Minimal-change build/typecheck/bundler fixes, stop after 3 failed attempts, and owner approval for major upgrades.
lines.mobile-web-code-review: Severity-ranked Mobile Web review for XSS/CSP/origin security, bridge parity, 100dvh/safe-area, and Core Web Vitals.
lines.mobile-web-design-a11y: Anti-template UI quality, 100dvh/safe-area ergonomics, >=44px touch targets, WCAG 2.2 AA, and 400% zoom reflow.
lines.mobile-web-patterns: ECC frontend patterns: component composition, separated server/client/URL/form state, SWR, and AbortController.
lines.mobile-web-performance-pwa: Core Web Vitals targets, bundle budgets, image/font loading, compositor-only motion, and safe PWA caching.
lines.mobile-web-planner: 4-step planning process, Search-First reuse, [MWB] contract intake, WebView bridge alignment, and Red Flags.
lines.mobile-web-tdd-testing: Vitest/Testing Library TDD, Playwright mobile viewports (320-1920px), touch checks, and bridge contract tests.
lines.mobile-web-verification-loop: 6-phase verification gate (build/bundle budget, typecheck/lint, unit/E2E, security/bridge diff, Vitals/a11y, acceptance).
lines.mobile-web-webview-bridge: Unified JS bridge client for Android/iOS (11 Device APIs), origin checks, browser fallback, and cross-bot sync.
lines.pr-review-checklist: Read a diff for behaviour changes, missing tests and risky edits; cite each finding.
lines.prd-authoring: 4-phase gated PRD workflow (FRAME -> GROUND -> DECIDE -> GENERATE) with a 3-platform parity matrix (Android, iOS, Mobile Web).
lines.product-capability: Translate PRD intent into a 3-platform Capability Contract locking shared WebView bridge, API, deep-link, and policy constraints.
lines.product-lens: Validate the why before building: product diagnostic (PRODUCT-BRIEF.md), user journey audit, and ICE prioritization.
lines.release-notes-style: Notes for users: new, fixed, changed; leave out refactors and code names.
lines.release-readiness: What blocks a release and how to list it: checks, reviews, open blockers.
lines.security-checklist: Secrets, injection, auth checks and unsafe defaults to look for in a change.
lines.spec-format: A one-page spec: problem, decision, scope, open questions.
lines.status-brief: Changed, blocked, needs a decision: a brief in under ten lines.
lines.swift-code-review: Severity-ranked Swift/ObjC iOS code review for safety, concurrency, ARC memory, protocols, SwiftUI, and Xcode.
lines.swift-concurrency-actors: Idiomatic Swift, Swift 6/6.2 strict concurrency (@MainActor, Sendable, @concurrent), ObjC interop, and actor persistence.
lines.swift-tdd-testing: TDD workflow with Swift Testing (@Test, #expect), XCTest (Swift/ObjC), Protocol DI mocks/fakes, and 80%+ coverage.
lines.work-breakdown: Break foundational specs into [AND]/[IOS]/[MWB] work briefs with dependency ordering and cross-bot review synchronization.
lines.workspace-hygiene: When a workspace is done or abandoned, and what to check before removing it.

adehone-dev.does: Plans and implements Electron process, IPC, security, and React UI work, fixes build errors, and reviews changes across desktop platforms, remote hosts, mobile impact, and folder workspaces.

pr-verify.trigger: When a pull request is opened or updated

adehone-dev.example1: Reported two feasibility questions on a work item before editing, then proved each done criterion with a hidden background run; Windows and SSH: unverified.
adehone-dev.example2: Flagged a new IPC handler with no sender check and a preload method that accepted any channel name.

It reads the repository’s own rules first, reports feasibility problems and questions before editing, then builds, proves the change by running it, verifies, and reviews. Anything it did not check is reported as unverified.
adehone-dev.line: Plans, builds, proves, and reviews Adehone features and fixes with Electron architecture and security guides.
adehone-dev.name: Adehone development
adehone-dev.reports: Here, after verification and when its checks run
adehone-dev.watches: Adehone workspaces, tasks, work items, and pull requests you hand it

bug-intake.does: Drafts a Linear issue with repro steps for each bug report; files it once approved.

bug-posted.trigger: When someone posts in your bugs channel

bug-intake.example1: Drafted: “Terminal freezes after sleep on macOS 27”, steps from the thread.
bug-intake.firstChat: Reads the channel you pick and drafts an issue for each new bug report. It files them only after you approve.

bug-investigation.does: Reproduces the bug in a new workspace, finds where it starts, and proposes a fix.

bug-investigation.example2: Cause: the paste end marker goes out before the final chunk. Start a fix?
bug-investigation.firstChat: Give it a bug report or an issue link. It starts an agent in a new workspace that writes down how to reproduce it, then reports the cause. It writes a fix only after you agree.

ci-failures.does: Tells flaky checks from real failures, explains each failure, and keeps a list of flaky checks.

check-failed.action: Say whether it’s flaky or real

ci-failures.example2: Flakiest this week: terminal-resize test, 4 of 30 runs.
ci-failures.firstChat: Reads the last two weeks of check runs and lists the flaky ones, then explains each failing check on your open pull requests. It starts a fix only after you agree.
ci-failures.line: Explains failed checks and keeps a list of flaky ones.

failure.agentCommandNotRunnable: {{agent}}'s Command in Settings → Agents must be a program path or name Adehone can find, with no arguments or variables. Change it or reset it.

failure.forkOriginalLatestOnly: {{agent}} can only fork the latest response in the original chat. Open that chat and fork its latest response once it has finished.
failure.forkOriginalLatestOnlyNamed: {{agent}} can only fork the latest response in "{{detail}}". Open that chat and fork its latest response once it has finished.
failure.forkOriginalMissing: {{agent}} could not find this response in the original chat. Open it and fork from there.
failure.forkOriginalMissingNamed: {{agent}} could not find this response in "{{detail}}". Open that chat and fork from there.
failure.forkOriginalUnavailable: {{agent}} cannot fork this response in the original chat. Open it and fork from there.
failure.forkOriginalUnavailableNamed: {{agent}} cannot fork this response in "{{detail}}". Open that chat and fork from there.
failure.hostFault: Adehone ran into a problem, so this didn't go through.
failure.hostFaultTryAgain: Adehone ran into a problem, so this didn't go through. Try again.
failure.hostRestarted: Adehone restarted before this message was sent.
failure.hostStopped: {{agent}} never finished starting, so Adehone stopped it.
failure.launchPreparationFailed: Adehone couldn't prepare {{agent}} to start on the computer running this chat.
failure.pluginInputRequired: {{agent}} stopped because the "{{plugin}}" plugin is waiting for input in a terminal pane. Disable the plugin for chat sessions, or run the task in a {{agent}} terminal.
failure.providerResponseFailed: {{agent}} couldn't finish this response. Open Details for more information.
failure.providerSafetyStopped: {{agent}} stopped this response after a safety check. Review your request and send again.
failure.providerUnavailable: {{agent}} couldn't respond because the service is busy. Pick another model, or wait a little and send again.
failure.runtimeNotInstalled: {{agent}} isn't installed on the computer running this chat. Install it from the chat in a current version of Adehone.
failure.writeFailed: Adehone couldn't hand this message to the agent, so it was not sent.
